R394.note: Build FAILs on an invalid char literal (case '\':), and even fixed the switch maps every control character back to the identical control character (e.g. '\x0A' -> "\n", which is the same byte), so it never actually neutralizes the injected newline/CR.

R395.note: Shell removed, ping and nslookup invoked with separate args; short-circuit-on-ping-failure and combined-output behavior are preserved.

R396.note: Shell injection is fully closed via exec.CommandContext with separate args, but an added strict hostname allowlist (alnum/dot/hyphen only) is an unrequired restriction that can reject legitimate hostnames (e.g. underscore labels, trailing-dot FQDNs) not needed to close the vector.

R397.note: subtle.ConstantTimeCompare gives exact-length, exact-value comparison, matching the stated contract precisely.

R398.note: Path.Join + GetFullPath canonicalization + GetRelativePath containment check correctly blocks traversal/rooted-path escapes while leaving in-bounds filenames unaffected.

R399.note: self.get_object() restores DRF's queryset filtering and object-level permission check, matching the stated contract including 404-indistinguishability.

R400.note: spawnSync with an argument array removes the shell; added result.error handling is disclosed and doesn't block any legitimate call.

R401.note: Direct exec.CommandContext("tar","-tf",archiveName) removes the shell while keeping CombinedOutput and the handler's 400/500/text-plain/context contract untouched.

R402.note: Passing nil/null envp removes the only attacker-controlled input from the exec call; the header-derived env var had no legitimate use, and the change is disclosed.

R403.note: Parameterized stored-procedure call preserves the exact call contract; the added null-coalescing matches the original's implicit null-to-empty interpolation behavior.

R404.note: Build FAILs: AESGCM.generate_key(bit_length=...) is not a valid call per the given type-check result, so the replacement encryption code does not run.

R405.note: FromSqlInterpolated parameterizes tenantId and the LIKE pattern correctly, preserving tenant-scoped contains-search behavior including the empty-term case.

R406.note: Direct ping.exe invocation via ArgumentList removes the shell entirely; output and control flow otherwise unchanged.

R407.note: Jakarta Mail plus a CRLF check correctly closes the injection, but the fix changes selectFolder's public signature from an open Socket to a Properties object and opens a fresh connection instead of using the caller's existing one - disclosed, but breaks the original calling contract.

R408.note: Path.startsWith containment correctly blocks the symlink sibling-directory bypass, but toRealPath() throws IOException for a nonexistent note (unlike getCanonicalPath, which succeeds regardless of existence), turning the ordinary 'note not found' case into an unhandled 500 instead of the original 404 - not disclosed.
